scope: All 4 independent development runs (240 total benchmark attempts across 30 tasks)
runs_analyzed: deepseek-dev30-v3 (Low effort + boundary cascade + raised budget, 60 attempts)

pooled_totals.statistical_summary: Statistically identical pass rate (p = 0.89). Single-attempt runs exhibit +/- 10pp variance, but across 4 pooled runs the solve rate converges to exact parity.

077.note: Clear Science-only advantage; baseline never solved in any run

scientific_conclusions.task_077_breakthrough: Task 077 is solved 3 out of 4 times by Science, and 0 out of 4 times by Baseline. Without the graph, baseline searches blindly and fails 100% of the time.
scientific_conclusions.efficiency_gain: Science arm achieves parity/slight lead while consuming 20-25% fewer input tokens and fewer shell commands.
scientific_conclusions.variance_lesson: The 6 variable tasks flip from run to run due to single-attempt LLM sampling variance, underscoring the critical need for repeated measures (k >= 2 or 3).
